description: This file defines a REST API class for managing form data in the Superset application, including endpoints for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting form data, with associated request handling, validation, and error management.

classes.name: ExploreFormDataRestApi
classes.description: A REST API class for handling form data operations such as create, update, retrieve, and delete within the Superset application.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Creates new form data, validates input, and handles errors.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Updates existing form data identified by key, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves form data by key, with error handling.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes form data by key, with error handling.
